primitive: REG_GLM negative_binomial penalty l2 / l1 / elasticnet: theta re-estimated around the penalized fit (or fixed), glmnet's objective, unstandardised, intercept unpenalised
r_function: mpath::glmregNB(y ~ ., weights = w, lambda = alpha * N* * sum(pf) / nvars, alpha = l1_ratio, standardize = FALSE, penalty.factor = pf, thresh = 1e-14, maxit = 1e6, maxit.theta = 1000, parallel = FALSE[, nlambda = 1, theta.fixed = TRUE, theta0 = theta])
note: Pulse alpha = mpath lambda / N* (standardize = FALSE: mpath does not divide the loglik by sum(w)), times nvars / sum(pf) under unpenalized; Pulse l1_ratio = mpath alpha (l2 0, l1 1). rows are [x1, x2, x3, y, w]; N* = sum(w); w a frequency weight. theta_fixed 0 = theta estimated (theta.ml at the penalized means), else the fixed theta. std_errors: l2 the penalised-Fisher sandwich H^-1 A H^-1 at theta-hat; l1 / elasticnet null. theta_std_err: l2 with theta estimated 1/sqrt(info(theta-hat)); otherwise null. hat (unweighted cases): W x' H_S^-1 x over the intercept and the hat's active predictors. deviance: the NB deviance at theta-hat and the penalised estimate. Every case is self-checked against the KKT conditions of the stated objective at relative 1e-9 and, theta estimated, theta.ml at mpath's means.
